title: Journey status
description: Where each learner stands in each batch: learning, on a break, at risk, suspended. Shown on the learner list and the learner's profile. Status only: nothing is sent to learners.

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.hint: Rename, recolour and reorder the statuses. Each keeps its key, so changing a name never loses data.
statuses.label: Status name
statuses.duplicate: A status with this name already exists.
statuses.kindsHint: The kind decides how a status behaves: the At Risk check only moves learners on an Active status, and never touches a break, stopped or re-entry status.

rules.title: With Breaks and holds
rules.defaultHint: Every batch without a status of its own has this one.
rules.onPauseHint: Set on the paused batch (a stopped status is kept).
rules.onResumeHint: Set if the batch is still on a break status.

risk.title: At Risk check
risk.hint: Once a day, a learner on an Active status is marked at risk in a batch when either rule below holds. Set a rule to 0 to switch it off.
risk.toggle: Run the At Risk check every day
risk.classesHint: Missed each of the batch's last N classes (classes where attendance was taken).
risk.feeHint: The membership's due date is more than this many days past.
risk.autoReturn: Move them back to the new-enrolment status when they attend again or pay (only learners the check marked).
risk.noMessages: The check only changes the status. It sends no email, WhatsApp or notification.

offNote: Switching this off hides journey status everywhere. Saved statuses are kept for when it is switched on again.
audit: Every change is recorded on the learner's timeline with who made it, when and why.

reentry.title: Re-entry
reentry.hint: Start re-entry from the learner's profile: the batch moves to the Re-entry status, with an extra class or a bridge course to catch up.
reentry.autoReturn: Move back to {{status}} after the re-entry date
reentry.noStatus: Add a status of kind Re-entry to use the re-entry form.
